text:
Nora Patel: Follow-up from the latest DB-pool postmortem. We need concrete owners + short checkpoints to update runbooks and playbooks so this pattern doesn't repeat. Proposing a 10-day closure window for playbook edits and a 3-week window for automation.

Ibrahim Khan: I'll own the runbook edits for triage + escalation. Plan: add a one-page quick reference, a step-by-step triage block with exact shell and PromQL commands, and a failure-mode matrix mapping signals -> mitigations.

Zoe Lin: Please include an explicit "do-not" list. In the last incident repeated restarts made state worse. Example anti-pattern: "Do not restart pgbouncer more than once within 7 minutes unless safe-restart checks pass."

Marcus Hill: I'll prototype an incident-fingerprint scanner that looks for the same alert fingerprint across a 30-day window and files a follow-up ticket automatically. It will also append a suggested playbook edit template to the ticket. ETA: draft PR in 2 weeks.

AlertBot: ALERT SUMMARY: pgb_pool_waiting_clients fired 5 times in 75 days. Auto-ticket created: INF-10431.

Nora Patel: Action list (short):
- Runbook quick-ref + triage commands (owner: Ibrahim) — due 2026-04-08
- "Do-not" anti-pattern notes + safe-restart flow (owner: Zoe) — due 2026-04-06
- Fingerprint scanner prototype & ticket template (owner: Marcus) — due 2026-04-22
- Tabletop rehearsal (owner: Nora) — schedule by 2026-04-09, run 2026-04-13
I'll open GH issues and add the label postmortem-INF-10431.

Ibrahim Khan: Draft triage snippet to include in runbook (copyable):
```
# verify service health
ssh infra@db-primary-1 'systemctl is-active pgbouncer && pgbouncer-admin show pools'
# DB connection states
psql -h primary -U redwood -c "select state, count(*) from pg_stat_activity group by state;"
# prometheus checks (5m rate)
curl -s 'http://prometheus/api/v1/query?query=sum(rate(pgbouncer_connection_failures_total[5m])) by (job)'
```

Zoe Lin: Safe-restart flow suggestion: check KV cache hit ratio and active-waiting split before restart; require explicit ack from DB oncall if waiting_clients > 400. Also add an emergency traffic-shed play to move 30% of write traffic to a throttled queue.

Marcus Hill: The fingerprint scanner will tag incidents by signal family and threshold vector (e.g., waiting_clients>300 for 5m). When >=2 matches in 30d it will open INF follow-up and pre-fill: root cause hypotheses, suggested runbook text, and owners suggestion.

Nora Patel: We'll track progress in the GH issues. I'll add weekly check-ins on Fridays in #incidents and mark blockers early. If anyone needs extra time, post here with a new ETA. Thanks all. :pray:
